display.purpose: Page heroes and landing headlines. Lexend, tight -.03em tracking.

label.purpose: Uppercase Space Mono kickers introducing every section and field — the ledger's stamp.

shadows.name: gate-blur

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink pill for standard primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #080807; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 13px 28px; font-family: 'Cairo', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: .85; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #080807; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Amber CTA
components.description: The one highlighter — reserved for the single most important action per region.
components.css: .ds-btn-amber { background: #EF9043; color: #080807; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 12px 26px; font-family: 'Cairo', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: filter .15s; } .ds-btn-amber:hover { filter: brightness(.96); } .ds-btn-amber:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #080807; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary pill with 1px ink border (light world).
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: #080807; border: 1px solid #080807; border-radius: 999px; padding: 12px 26px; font-family: 'Cairo', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: rgba(8,8,7,.06); }

components.name: Mono Kicker Label
components.description: Uppercase Space Mono section/field label — the system's signature texture.
components.css: .ds-kicker { font-family: 'Space Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #66666B; }

components.name: Tier Badge
components.description: Rigor tier indicator: colored tick marks plus mono label in the tier color.
components.css: .ds-tier { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; } .ds-tier-tick { width: 6px; height: 12px; border-radius: 1px; background: #3C6E5A; display: inline-block; } .ds-tier-label { font-family: 'Space Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #3C6E5A; margin-left: 5px; }

components.name: Catalog Card
components.description: Surface card with category color top-band and hairline border.
components.html:
PsychBench-Dx
Diagnostic reasoning over 196 psychiatry vignettes.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #E2E2E2; border: 1px solid #CFCFCF; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; width: 260px; } .ds-card-band { height: 8px; background: #4F7183; } .ds-card-body { padding: 18px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 400; color: #080807; letter-spacing: -.01em; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-card-desc { font-family: 'Cairo', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #66666B; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Dark Field
components.description: Night-world input: translucent bone fill with mono kicker label.
components.css: .ds-field-label { font-family: 'Space Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8C887E; margin-bottom: 6px; display: block; } .ds-field { width: 220px; background: rgba(237,235,228,.06); border: 1px solid rgba(237,235,228,.2); border-radius: 8px; padding: 11px 13px; color: #EDEBE4; font-family: 'Cairo', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; outline: none; } .ds-field:focus-visible { border-color: rgba(237,235,228,.5); }

narrative.overview: Benchly reads like a rigorous, modern registry: evidence recorded in near-black ink on off-white grey paper, with exactly one highlighter — signature amber — reserved for the moments that matter. Monochrome by conviction, sharp and contemporary in voice, with muted semantic tier and category colors doing the only other talking. Two inverted registers share one voice: the light catalog world for browsing, the night world for landing, methodology, and the access gate.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome ink-on-paper base; color is always semantic or the single amber accent
Humanist-modern display over a classical serif body: Lexend headlines, Cairo text, Space Mono uppercase labels
Pill-shaped interactive elements against rectangular hairline-bordered data surfaces
Two inverted registers (paper catalog / night landing) sharing one voice

rules.name: The One Highlighter Rule
rules.body: Amber appears only where the user should act or look next — never as decoration, never more than one amber element per viewport region. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Every non-neutral color on screen must mean something (a tier, a category, or the accent). No mood colors.

rules.name: The Mono Kicker Rule
rules.body: Every section and form field is introduced by a Space Mono uppercase label with wide tracking. It is the ledger's stamp.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: No box-shadows at rest. Separation comes from tone and hairline, matching the printed-registry metaphor.

dos: Do keep amber (#EF9043) paired exclusively with ink text and limited to one focal action per region.
Do introduce every section/field with a Space Mono uppercase kicker (.12em+ tracking).
Do use pills for anything clickable and small radii (8–18px) for anything that holds content.
Do pull semantic colors from the existing tier and category palettes rather than inventing new hues.
donts: Don't add box-shadows at rest or gradients outside the amber data-bars.
Don't introduce new accent colors — the system is monochrome plus amber plus semantic hues.
Don't use light text on amber, or amber on the light paper background in large fields.
Don't substitute the committed faces (Lexend / Cairo / Space Mono) or add new font families.
